system.description:
Moving faster than the human eye can follow, you blur across the landscape with a cheetah's speed while the bystanders around you seem frozen as statues.

Activate Legerity and all your lower Celerity levels for the turn at the cost of one Blood Trait. Legerity grants one additional normal action at the end of the turn, on top of the action from Swiftness — so you have at least three actions, plus your Alacrity preempt and the Bomb in challenges of speed. Actions gained from Legerity come after your basic and Swiftness actions, at the very end of the turn. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
